overview_description.description: Human Interest offers retirement plan administration and investment advisory services focused on small and medium-sized businesses. The company provides 401(k) and 403(b) plans, including traditional, Roth, safe harbor, and profit-sharing designs, along with IRA solutions. Its platform integrates with hundreds of payroll providers to automate contributions, recordkeeping, and many compliance-related tasks, including selected government filings. Through Human Interest Advisors, it delivers model portfolios, low-cost fund lineups, and digital investment guidance for plan participants. Employers can configure eligibility, matching, and vesting features, while employees access web and mobile tools, onboarding support, and ongoing educational resources to manage their retirement savings.
